topic: Geologic Time Scale and Fossil Dating
key_concepts: Fossils can be used to determine the relative ages of rock layers.
A fossil's known geologic range indicates the periods when that organism lived.
Overlapping fossil ranges can narrow a rock layer's age to a specific period.
A single fossil with a range spanning multiple periods cannot date a layer to one specific
The geologic time scale spans about 4,570 million years.
Earth history can be compressed into a one-year calendar to visualize deep time.
At about 3,400 million years ago, bacteria dominated Earth.
Cambrian, Ordovician, Silurian, and Devonian are successive geologic periods.
